title: ux-sim curated analysis
description: The second, curated layer over findings.json. An orchestrating Claude session reads findings.json and the per-run reports and writes the PROBLEMS it sees: a plain-language title, a root-cause hypothesis, who was affected, evidence, severity, whether it is an environment limit, a suggested fix, and which heuristic fingerprints it groups. `ux-sim issues --analysis` turns problems into issue candidates. AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour. See docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md.

severity.description: 1 minor · 2 moderate · 3 major · 4 blocker (same scale as run.json)

screenshot.description: repo-relative path; filled from run.json when omitted

quote.description: persona words, verbatim from the run

note.description: what the analyst saw at this step (screen, request, harness signal)

author.description: who wrote it, e.g. 'orchestrating Claude session <link>'

findings.description: repo-relative path of the findings.json this analysis curates

harness.description: harness content hash of the runs (run.json harness.hash)

key.description: stable slug for dedupe across dates (keep it when re-analysing the same problem)

title.description: plain language, what a student experiences — not 'Confusing UI on /'

rootCauseHypothesis.description: why it happens — a hypothesis, name the screen/copy/flow

confidence.description: how sure the analyst is that this is one real problem (not how many users hit it)

environmentLimited.description: true when it only happens because of the test environment (local stack, live guard, demo account) — never filed

suggestedFix.description: a hypothesis, the smallest change worth trying

fingerprints.description: heuristic findings.json clusters this problem groups (empty only for problems seen in run reports but not logged as friction, e.g. a false success)

file.description: force (true) or suppress (false) an issue candidate; default rule: severity ≥ 3 or ≥ 2 personas, never when environmentLimited

dismissed.description: heuristic fingerprints deliberately not turned into problems (noise, persona over-reading, duplicate of another problem's evidence)

harnessIssues.description: problems with the harness or scenario, not the app (loose success check, persona broke a rule)
